variables.name: LVBT_PREVIEW_BINDINGS
variables.purpose: Reviewed named-staging binding declarations as JSON: real isolated preview D1 ID, separate Durable Object Worker, distinct account-scoped limiter namespaces, canonical public vars/assets, and the shared read-only GTFS bucket. This repository-level declaration is read by build, source verification, and both publication environments.

secrets.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Deploy Workers, migrate production and preview databases, clean previews, and refresh GTFS archives.
steps: Select the Las Vegans for Better Transit account, then Manage Account → Account API Tokens. A Super Administrator creates this account-owned token.
Choose Create Token → Create Custom Token; name it TransitMapper deploy (GitHub Actions).
Grant Account Workers Scripts Edit, Workers R2 Storage Edit, D1 Edit, and Account Settings Read; grant Zone Zone Read and Workers Routes Edit. R2 access is needed for GTFS feed refresh.
Restrict Account Resources to the LVBT account and Zone Resources to lasvegasfortransit.org. Do not select all accounts or zones.
Review the expiry against the organization credential policy and ensure maintainers track renewal before deployments stop.
Create the token and paste it into the maintainer bootstrap prompt immediately. The shared setup stores it on both GitHub environments and does not print it.

The existing account-level token serves production and preview. Separate GitHub environments record deployments; they do not constrain Cloudflare token rights. Existing credentials are preserved unless explicit rotation is requested.

secrets.name: CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID
secrets.purpose: Authenticate retained release acceptance to the protected TransitMapper staging origin only. Never forwarded to production or third-party requests.
steps: A maintainer configures Access for transitmapper-preview.las-vegas-for-better-transit.workers.dev with anonymous denial and a service-authentication policy.
Select the approved service token in Zero Trust, Access, Service Auth. Record its client ID and secret in the matching preview environment prompts; keep the pair in the same environment.
Do not reuse production deployment credentials or move Access credentials into a production job. Verify anonymous denial and an authenticated marker request before promotion.
